title: D. Absolute Cinema
statement:
There is a hidden sequence a_1,a_2,…,a_n of n integers (n ≥ 2). It is guaranteed that |a_i| ≤ 1000 for all 1 ≤ i ≤ n.

Let's define a function f(x) as follows:

f(x)=∑_{i=1}^n a_i·|i-x|

Given n values f(1),f(2),…,f(n), please determine the values of a_1,a_2,…,a_n.

It is guaranteed that the values a_1,a_2,…,a_n can be determined uniquely.

Each test contains multiple test cases. The first line contains the number of test cases t (1 ≤ t ≤ 10^4). The description of the test cases follows.

The first line of each test case contains a single integer n (colorred2 ≤ n ≤ 300,000).

The second line of each test case contains n integers f(1),f(2),…,f(n) (-10^14 ≤ f(i) ≤ 10^14).

It is guaranteed that the sum of n over all test cases does not exceed 300,000.

For each test case, output n integers a_1,a_2,…,a_n on a separate line (|a_i| ≤ 1000).

It is guaranteed that the values a_1,a_2,…,a_n can be determined uniquely.

In the first test case, the hidden sequence is a=[1,4,2,3].

The values f(1),f(2),…,f(n) are as follows:

Input:
```
4417 9 9 136-37 -32 -15 4 27 425-26 -32 -24 -4 22420 -69
```

Output:
```
1 4 2 33 6 1 2 -4 -7-6 7 6 -7 -6-69 420
```
